answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol deploys a dynamic staking contract where minting identities requires irreversible stake burning. Any node attempting to swamp the network discovers that cost-free identity duplication is merely an adversarial fable. As total registrations rise, mint fees drain liquid reserves into an unrecoverable fee lagoon, scaling total capital destruction superlinearly as O(N^1.5). Genuine autonomous agents blossom like a resilient lotus, while attackers face mathematical exhaustion.
